arcs.text: The frozen shapes suspended in the ice-like walls may be victims the party could free or must pass.
The party must decide what to do about the massive iron chain and lift platform built and maintained by someone unknown.
The maddened robed creature that climbed the chain and demanded the seal be broken is still unaccounted for.
The three letters Serenola sent to House Nightriver were never seen by Max — who intercepted or discarded them, and why.
Max intends to tell Garreth what happened to the crew in person.
Who intercepted or discarded Serenola's three letters to House Nightriver, and why — Serenola now openly questions whether the house knew and did not care.
Max has sworn to Serenola to find out whether House Nightriver received and discarded her three letters, and she will hold him to it.
A grieving townsfolk woman whose son died in the mine is approaching the party for answers.
The grieving townsfolk mother whose son died in the mine now knows the party killed the thing that took him — whether she accepts their account or demands more remains open.
Max has been summoned to his father's study at the Nightriver estate — what Lord Javon wants is unknown.
Baroness Serenola waits in her study to speak about House Nightriver, and Max has sworn to learn whether the house received and discarded her three letters.
The party has been promoted to B-rank and must return to the Aegis City Guild Hall to claim the badge and rewards.
Riyo's refusal of a room and her guarded vigil by the estate door — what she is hiding and why she will not settle in.
Welden is behaving strangely and refuses to explain what is troubling him.
Javon has confronted Max about letters sent to the house, holding a letter with a grain-stalk seal — what he knows about Serenola's three unanswered letters is unresolved.
Javon has admitted the estate deliberately 'handled' Serenola's letters — what that purpose was, and who ordered it, is unresolved.
Welden is in the library, jumpier than usual and refusing to explain what troubles him.
Javon suspects Max has been receiving letters he knows nothing about — who is writing to Max, and what Javon will do about it, is unresolved.
Javon's stated purpose for 'handling' Serenola's letters remains unexplained — who ordered it and why is unresolved.
Javon has set three conditions Max must meet before he will reveal the truth of the house's seals and marriages — whether Max meets them, and what the truth is, is unresolved.
The truth of the Nightriver seals and the Witch King — Max now knows the bloodline is the prison, but how to act on it, and what Javon's three conditions will reveal, is unresolved.
Javon has named the entity beneath Driftmere 'Tzarak' and claims killing it altered the balance of powers beneath the mountains — what that disruption means is unresolved.

Javon has named the Witch King a prison and the Nightriver bloodline his jailers — how Max will act on the knowledge that his blood is the seal, and whether he will break or preserve the line, is unresolved.
Javon's three conditions (explain the mines, name Serenola's source, accept some questions must wait) stand between Max and the full truth of the house — whether Max meets them is unresolved.
Riyo's hidden left arm — what she is concealing under the cloak, and why she panicked when Max asked, is unresolved.
Welden is acting jumpier than usual and will not say why — what is troubling him is unresolved.
Belle has publicly contradicted Max's claim that Garreth's crew came home alive — whether the party's lie to the townsfolk unravels, and how Max handles Belle's openness, is unresolved.
Javon knows the Guild's report says the entity beneath the mines was disrupted — how much the Guild and others know of what the party did below Driftmere is unresolved.
Natalia knows about the seals and the missing letters, and has confronted Max directly — what she wants and how much she knows is unresolved.
Belle has openly contradicted Max's lie about Garreth's crew in front of the household — whether the townsfolk's belief unravels is unresolved.
Riyo's panic at Max's question about her arms — what she hides under the cloak and why she gripped her sword — is unresolved.
The balance altered by breaking the seal and killing Tzarak — what changed and what Javon fears is unresolved.
Whether Max admits the truth about Garreth's crew and the seal to Javon, and how Natalia's knowledge of the lie affects the household, is unresolved.
What Natalia wants in exchange for her knowledge of the seals and the missing letters is unresolved.

Javon demands Max explain his conduct at the mines and name the source of Serenola's story before he will reveal more — whether Max tells the truth about breaking the seal and killing Tzarak is unresolved.
Natalia knows Max lied about Garreth's crew and the seal and is pressing him on what he will admit to Javon — what she wants in exchange is unresolved.
Whether Max confesses the Driftmere lie, the broken seal, and the Tzarak's death to Javon, and how he handles Javon's demand to accept the marriages, is unresolved.
What the altered balance beneath the mountains means now that Tzarak is dead is unresolved.
Whether Belle's open contradiction of Max's lie unravels the household's belief is unresolved.
Whether Max's partial admission to Belle and Dalan spreads to Javon and forces a full confession about the Devourer is unresolved.
